marc:datafield.marc:subfield: Pop culture : a view from the paparazzi

"Justin Timberlake was already an accomplished singer when he joined his friend J.C. Chasez and three others to form 'N Sync. Soon, the group produced a string of hits and shot to the top of the pop music charts. As the members of 'N Sync grew older, they realized they had taken the group as far as they could so they split up to pursue solo careers. Clearly, Justin's star has shined the brightest. Since going out on his own, he has recorded two best-selling albums and embarked on a busy film career. Justin remains committed to his music and plans to continue recording for years to come. Because of his popularity, he finds himself constantly pursued by the tabloid press, which is eager to report on his relationships with some of the entertainment world's hottest stars, including Britney Spears, Cameron Diaz, and Jenna Dewan."
